Biology was modulated but not uniformly in the expected anti-proliferative direction. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint failed - Ki67 proliferation marker did not decrease as intended. Treatment group showed minimal change (1539 to 1575 cells/mm²) while placebo increased more (1556 to 1864 cells/mm²), but this difference was not statistically significant. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported in this small study (n=27). 5. CONFOUNDERS: Small sample size (n=27) likely underpowered for detecting modest effects on proliferation biomarker.

Small sample size of only 27 patients total, no p-value reported for primary endpoint, likely insufficient power to detect modest changes in proliferation biomarker
